price_field_note: This price book is titled 'Dealer Cost Pricing' (effective November 1, 2025). The dealer_price field is populated with the dealer cost - the wholesale price Benson pays MagraHearth. No MSRP/retail column is published; msrp left null. INTERNAL USE ONLY - contains dealer cost pricing not for customer distribution. Notes: CCL (Custom Color) variants add a $175 custom color charge ($170 for the Natty XL series). Items priced 'CALL FOR PRICING' (3-Piece and 4-Piece Surrounds) and 'QUOTE' (CST-CUT-03 special custom cut) have dealer_price left null. Full-size showroom display items are eligible for a 50% dealer discount per the Showroom Displays page.
